description: This file contains database migration scripts for the Superset project, specifically adding and removing a 'type' field in native filter configurations within dashboard metadata.

classes.name: Dashboard
classes.description: SQLAlchemy ORM model representing dashboards with a json_metadata field.

methods.name: upgrade
methods.description: Adds a 'type' field with value 'NATIVE_FILTER' to each native_filter_configuration in dashboard json_metadata.

methods.name: downgrade
methods.description: Removes the 'type' field from each native_filter_configuration in dashboard json_metadata.
